title: Visualizing Local Maxima of the Ohio overdose epidemic with Vineyards
summary: Understanding how spatial patterns evolve over time is a complex task that often arises in the analysis of public health data. In this work, we investigate the use of vineyards from topological data analysis (TDA) in this setting by applying them to time series data related to the overdose epidemic in the state of Ohio. We begin by proposing statistical tests that can be used in order to evaluate whether vineyards are a reasonable technique to study a spatiotemporal dataset.
